affiliations.occupation: Translator, classification specialist, job analyst, interpreter, or employment interviewer (code 068)
affiliations.date_precision: The official enlistment record carries civilian occupation code 068 at Army entry on 23 March 1943. The secondary code table supplies a multi-occupation group and no employer.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact name and private service identifier match the index row. The full code group is published without choosing a specific occupation or inferring an employer.

affiliations.occupation: Repair or maintenance trade (code 583; exact occupation indeterminate)
affiliations.date_precision: The official enlistment record carries civilian occupation code 583 at Army entry on 21 July 1943. The secondary code table covers numerous mechanical and equipment-repair trades and no employer.
affiliations.research_notes: The private identifier confirms the official row, and the Clark County catalog independently names the same person and Army/OSS service. Code 583 does not identify one trade. The institutional catalog's later service-start date is preserved as a conflict.

affiliations.occupation: Telephone/telegraph installer-repairman, chief clerk, railway-shop dispatcher, production manager, or entertainment director (code 097)
affiliations.date_precision: The official enlistment record carries civilian occupation code 097 at Army entry on 9 June 1943. The secondary code table supplies five possible occupations and no employer.
affiliations.research_notes: The private identifier matches the index and Army file and is repeated in a contemporary OSS award record. The obituary independently confirms OSS service. The full code group is preserved without inferring a specific job or Baumgold Brothers employment.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Arthur V. Bauman is confirmed as the Army enlistee represented by the exact-name record in the official merged enlistment file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact name and private service identifier match across the OSS index and official Army enlistment file; the full identifier is not public.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by an exact full-name and unique private-identifier match, with enlisted Army service compatible across the records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The official record dates Army entry to 23 March 1943; the index establishes later OSS personnel-file inclusion but supplies no assignment date.
claims.match_notes: The decisive identifier is retained only in the private database and masked in the public interface and exports.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry in March 1943, Arthur V. Bauman's civilian occupation was recorded under ambiguous code 068.
claims.evidence_excerpt: TRANSLATOR or CLASSIFICATION SPECIALIST or JOB ANALYST or INTERPRETER or EMPLOYMENT INTERVIEWER
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official enlistment row carries code 068; the secondary code table supplies five possible occupations but names no employer.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The private unique-identifier match confirms that the enlistment row belongs to the indexed person.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded to Army entry on 23 March 1943, but it does not establish exact work dates or which listed occupation applied.
claims.match_notes: Published as an ambiguous occupation group with NARA's documented interpretation and conversion limitations. No employer or single occupation is inferred.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Howard E. Baumgardner is confirmed as the Army enlistee documented in the official merged file and the Clark County veterans catalog.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Baumgardner, Howard E. (Bummy) ... Sergeant, U. S. Army ... Tank Destroyer, OSS
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The private identifier matches the official Army row; the institutional catalog independently repeats the exact name and Army/OSS service. The Army file gives 21 July 1943, while the catalog gives 11 August 1943.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact name and unique private-identifier match, independently corroborated by the uncommon exact name, Ohio context, Army service, and explicit OSS notation.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army file dates entry to 21 July 1943; the institutional catalog gives 11 August 1943. The conflict remains unresolved.
claims.match_notes: The start-date conflict is preserved. Later Sergeant and indexed Pfc grades can reflect promotion, but the project does not silently reconcile them.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry in July 1943, Howard E. Baumgardner's civilian occupation was recorded under broad repair-and-maintenance code 583.
claims.evidence_excerpt: GUNSMITH ... DIESEL MECHANIC ... CAMERA REPAIRMAN ... INSTRUMENT REPAIRMAN ... UTILITY REPAIRMAN ... RADIO REPAIRMAN
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official row carries code 583; the secondary table maps it to numerous mechanical and equipment-repair trades but no employer.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The private identifier confirms the official enlistment row, and the institutional veterans catalog independently corroborates the exact person and OSS service.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded to official Army entry on 21 July 1943. The Clark County catalog instead gives 11 August 1943 as the service start.
claims.match_notes: Published as a broad repair-and-maintenance group. No employer or single trade is inferred, and the start-date conflict remains visible.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Theodore Baumgold is confirmed as the Army enlistee and OSS master sergeant documented in two official identifier-linked records.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index, Army merged file, and contemporary OSS award record carry the exact uncommon name and matching private identifier; an obituary independently confirms OSS service.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by the exact uncommon name and unique private identifier across two official record systems, with independent published-obituary corroboration.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army file dates entry to 9 June 1943; the official OSS award record is dated 24 April 1945.
claims.match_notes: The full identifier is withheld. The obituary's undated businessman description and later corporate records are not used to infer prewar employment.
